slides.title: The `border` Property 🖼️
Border Styles Showcase

quizData.question: The `border` shorthand requires at least the ______ property to be visible.
quizData.explanation: If `border-style` is missing or `none`, the border won't appear regardless of width and colour.

slides.title: `border-radius`: Round Those Corners 🔘
slides.content:
# Soften the Edges

`border-radius` takes length values (px, %, etc.).

```css
.box { border-radius: 10px; }           /* all corners */
.box { border-radius: 10px 20px; }     /* top-left+bot-right, top-right+bot-left */
.box { border-radius: 10px 20px 30px 40px; } /* individual corners */
```
A value of `50%` on a square turns it into a circle!

You can target corners individually: `border-top-left-radius`, etc.

slides.title: Circle with CSS
Outline vs Border 🆚

quizData.question: Adding an outline increases the element's size.
quizData.explanation: Outlines are drawn outside the border without affecting layout; they overlap nearby content.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use `box-shadow` for Multiple Borders

Need more than one border? `box-shadow` with zero blur and spread can simulate additional borders without extra elements.
